name: Chimeros: Aurum Apostolum
detailed_description:
Chimeros: Aurum Apostolum is a RPG creature collector at heart Focused on exploring and unraveling the mysteries of a strange new world you are transported to with your chosen team of "Chimeros" creatures. Within this exotic adventure, Take on the role as a lost anthropologist attempting to solve a mysterious journal while traversing the sprawling Isle Chimeros.

  • The "Chimeros": 9 Types of creatures, with 9 different elemental affinities to pick from. Each pairing creates a line of 6 stages, each one growing in power and evolving as you train, grow, and bond with your chosen partners!

  • Evolution: Always a choice, never an accident. With evolution being a choice, you pick when you evolve after hitting each stage of evolutions level cap. Be warned, Evolution is Randomized, and follows a simple set of rules, Each stage will have either the same Type or Element as the previous form.

  • Exploration: 9 Different environments, From lush jungle to the lost ruins of a desert kingdom, mountains carved into monoliths or a spire at the edge of the atmosphere, all for you to explore and seek out the secrets of. Find the heart of each region to dive into the greatest challenges available to you

  • Dungeons: Unlike other Creature Collectors, Chimeros: Aurum Apostolum has Dungeons more akin to typical RPG games of the same visual era. Each dungeon you dive into will have a rogue-lite designs, shuffling the order of floors and puzzles. Making every run dynamic and difficulty change floor to floor until you find yourself in fron to fhte final challenge, our legendary beasts known as "Ancients"

  • Care: Chimeros are creatures. Care and bond with them, sharing meals, and play mini-games to boost their stats. Spending time with your team may result in strange occurrences with Evolution.

  • Crafting and Cooking: Your camp is your lifeblood. A base of operations that you stem every expedition from. Each trip brings back a bounty of rewards from shards, to plants, and even evolution materials. Use these materials and foods to make medicines, and cook meals to share with your Chimeros!

  • Elemental Traces: combat in Chimeros: Aurum Aposotlum moves quickly, Strategy is your ally. Fill the Trace meter to call upon the lingering powers of the land to lay elemental vestiges on the battlefield, then chain elements off of them to cause devastating effects.

  • The Golden Isle: As you explore and search for information to fill out the journal, You grow ever closer to the final goal. The Golden Isle on the horizon. almost always visible, but ever out of reach.

short_description: Chimeros: Aurum Apostolum is a Creature collector, rogue-lite RPG where you explore the forgotten Chimeros Isle, capture and care for your new allies, master turn-based combat. Build your party, uncover dark secrets, and find the source of the Island on the horizon
